scripts.install:all: npm i --prefix gateway && npm i --prefix services/core && npm i --prefix services/tickets
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,core,tickets -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix services/core" "npm run dev --prefix services/tickets"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,core,tickets -c cyan,green,yellow "npm start --prefix gateway" "npm start --prefix services/core" "npm start --prefix services/tickets"
